# Bianet

> > Independent news portal covering Turkish politics, human rights, Kurdish issues, and Middle Eastern affairs with critical analysis and investigative journalism.

Bianet is Turkey's leading independent news organization providing in-depth coverage of political developments, civil liberties, education policy, and regional geopolitics. The platform features reporting on Turkish parliamentary affairs, Ministry of National Education (MEB) policies, opposition party activities, and expert commentary on Middle Eastern politics.

## Key Topics

- Turkish Politics & Parliamentary Affairs (TBMM)
- Human Rights & Civil Liberties
- Kurdish Issue & Minority Rights
- Education Policy & MEB Regulations
- Middle East Politics (Iran, Syria, Palestine)
- Opposition Politics (CHP & Other Parties)
- Judicial System & Political Trials
- Language Policy & Turkish Language Institution (TDK)
- Social Media & Digital Rights
- Regional Analysis (Istanbul, Samsun, Silivri)
- Political Commentary (Arslan Özdemir, Evrim Kepenek, Gilbert Achcar)
- Secularism & Religious Policy
- Press Freedom & Journalism
- International Relations (US, Iran, Middle East)

## Main Portal

- [Bianet](https://bianet.org/): Homepage of Bianet news portal covering Turkish politics and human rights

## Political News & Current Affairs

- [Sosyal medya fenomenleri Mükremin Gezgin ve Arya Bektaş gözaltına alındı](https://bianet.org/haber/sosyal-medya-fenomenleri-mukremin-gezgin-ve-arya-bektas-gozaltina-alindi-316279): Social media influencers detained in Istanbul on drug-related charges

## Education Policy & Analysis

- [2025-2026 Eğitim ve Öğretim Yılı'na ilişkin MEB'in genelgesi](https://bianet.org/yazi/2025-2026-egitim-ve-ogretim-yili-na-iliskin-mebin-genelgesi-310818): Analysis of MEB's 2025-2026 education circular by Arslan Özdemir
- [MEB'in Ramazan Genelgesi: Eğitim politikalarında yeni bir yönelim mi?](https://bianet.org/yazi/mebin-ramazan-genelgesi-egitim-politikalarinda-yeni-bir-yonelim-mi-317015): Arslan Özdemir critiques MEB's Ramadan circular and secularism in education

## Historical & Cultural Analysis

- [Şapka Kanununa Muhalefetten İdamlar ve İstiklal Mahkemesi Yargılamaları](https://bianet.org/haber/sapka-kanununa-muhalefetten-idamlar-ve-istiklal-mahkemesi-yargilamalari-118483): Historical account of executions under 1925 Hat Law by İstiklal Mahkemesi

## Language & Cultural Policy

- [TDK, Kurum İsimlerinde Kesme İşareti Kullanımını Kaldırdı](https://bianet.org/haber/tdk-kurum-isimlerinde-kesme-isareti-kullanimini-kaldirdi-179087): TDK removes apostrophe rule for institutional names in Turkish grammar
